=={{header|Omegese}}==
{{works with|omc|sha256 2c824805, aien-dev/omega-mv e5b32567, Linux AArch64}}
Omega has no imports, so the small output helpers (<code>emit</code> and friends) are part of the program.
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
om2
text nl "\n"
text sp " "
text minus "-"
text tgen "generation "
text tdot "."
text thash "#"
global cur uchar 64
global nxt uchar 64
global dim ulong 2
note emit writes every byte of a to stdout; a short write is retried, an error exits 1
fn emit a view uchar * to void
o = ulong 0
while lt o len a bound 4096
k = write 1 a o sub len a o
if le k 0
exit 1
end
o = add o ulong k
end
end
note emitu writes n in decimal; 20 digits hold every ulong
fn emitu n ulong to void
d = new uchar 20 0
i = ulong 20
v = n
while true bound 20
i = sub i 1
put d i uchar add rem v 10 48
v = div v 10
if eq v 0
break
end
end
emit part d i sub 20 i
end
note the board is dim[0] rows by dim[1] columns, row by row, with dead cells beyond the edges; a live
note cell with 2 or 3 live neighbours lives on, a dead one with exactly 3 comes alive
fn alive r long c long to ulong
if or or lt r 0 ge r long get dim 0 or lt c 0 ge c long get dim 1
ret 0
end
ret ulong get cur add mul ulong r get dim 1 ulong c
end
fn around r long c long to ulong
n = ulong 0
for a ulong 3
for b ulong 3
if or ne a 1 ne b 1
n = add n alive sub add r long a 1 sub add c long b 1
end
end
end
ret n
end
fn step to void
w = get dim 1
for r ulong get dim 0
for c ulong w
n = around long r long c
v = uchar 0
if eq n 3
v = 1
end
if and eq n 2 eq get cur add mul r w c 1
v = 1
end
put nxt add mul r w c v
end
end
for i ulong mul get dim 0 w
put cur i get nxt i
end
end
fn show g ulong to void
emit tgen
emitu g
emit nl
w = get dim 1
for r ulong get dim 0
for c ulong w
if eq get cur add mul r w c 1
emit thash
else
emit tdot
end
end
emit nl
end
end
fn run gens ulong to void
for g ulong add gens 1
show g
if lt g gens
step
end
end
end
fn main to int
note a blinker on a 3 x 3 board for 3 generations
put dim 0 3
put dim 1 3
for i ulong 9
put cur i 0
end
put cur 3 1
put cur 4 1
put cur 5 1
run 2
emit nl
note a glider on an 8 x 8 board; after 4 generations it has moved one cell down and right
put dim 0 8
put dim 1 8
for i ulong 64
put cur i 0
end
put cur 1 1
put cur 10 1
put cur 16 1
put cur 17 1
put cur 18 1
run 4
ret 0
end
</syntaxhighlight>
